department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by January 3 (2027 assumed) for Fall entry; the catalog still lists the January 6, 2026 date, so confirm with the department.
deadline.quote: The deadline for submission of application materials for Fall semester admission is January 3. | Students wishing to be considered for financial aid should apply for Fall admission.

gre_subject.value: No subject test exists for this field.

gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) Aptitude Test is optional for all students but submission of the GRE is allowed to supplement your application.

supervisor.value: No pre-application supervisor requirement is mentioned.

funding.value: Qualified PhD students are typically supported on research assistantships; fellowships are competitive and mainly for Fall entrants.
funding.quote: Graduate research assistantships typically support qualified Ph.D. students.

entry_route.value: Apply with a B.S.; non-chemical-engineering graduates may need extra courses.
entry_route.quote: The programs leading to the Master of Science and Doctor of Philosophy degrees are open to qualified students holding the Bachelor of Science degree.

notes: The department admissions page also cites an old TOEFL iBT 100 rule for unconditional admission; Graduate School minimums are the current reference.
